verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 'Remixing' lets users copy an existing project as a starting point (lovable-docs-13), and community evidence shows one user 'picked a template' during signup (lovable-comm-2), indicating template-based starts exist. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated template gallery, categorized starter templates, or a community project marketplace/showcase to browse and fork from — the core flow emphasized in docs is still prompt-first generation. Missing for 10: a documented template gallery/library, community-submitted project directory, and evidence of discoverability/browsing UX for templates.
